title: Workshop Record and the Rate a Repair Cost Is Accepted At
content:
Where a vehicle protected by the Keyturn Host Protection Plan is kept under a Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan and serviced in the partner network, the marketplace accepts more of the repair cost the appraisal establishes.

- Where the vehicle carries an active care plan and two or more workshop visits on it in the partner network stand in the six months before, the cost is accepted at the full partner-network rate, a rate of 1, leaving the cost whole.
- Where the vehicle carries an active care plan and fewer than two such visits stand in that period, it is accepted at the marketplace's out-of-network repair rate of 90 percent.
- Where the vehicle carries no active care plan, it is accepted at the marketplace's unmanaged-repair rate of 80 percent.

### Worked illustration (hypothetical figures)

On a cost of 5000 established by the appraisal, the three readings give 5000, 4500 and 4000 respectively.

| Care plan on the vehicle | Partner-network visits in the six months before | Cost accepted at |
|---|---|---|
| Active | 2 or more | the whole of it |
| Active | fewer than 2 | 90 percent |
| None | any number | 80 percent |

A vehicle with no active care plan is on the unmanaged-repair rate however many partner-network visits stand on it.

### The record the reading is taken from

The standing of the care plan and the workshop visits carried out in the partner network are read from the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan held on that vehicle, counting visits within the six months before.
